string: Texture office census, READ-ONLY, in every build. Runs uv_corruption, normal_corruption and stuck_low_mip in census mode (no allocation, draw or slot change; the mode step is skipped) with the effective cap and all-or-nothing, over the auto-pool's candidate set now (name-sorted), or with 'all' over every renderable actor in the loaded levels, and prints IAI-TEXCORRUPT-CENSUS v1 counts, including blurry eligibility per route: no actor, component, asset, path or map names. TIME-SLICED: about 4 ms of work per frame (the 'all' actor listing too: one cheap snapshot of actor pointers, then each actor's renderable test in slices, then evaluation from the next frame), a progress line every 2 s once the listing is done, and a hard stop at 120 s that prints the counts so far with 'scanned=K of=N stopped=time_limit'; it never blocks a frame for long. The end line reports the frames it spanned, its longest single frame of work (work_ms_max) and the longest frame-to-frame interval while it ran (frame_interval_ms_max). A 'subs' line per type counts the first refusal with its sub-reason (reason/sub; subs that could name content are reduced to the reason). 'allreasons' scans like 'all' but evaluates EVERY check for every candidate instead of stopping at the first failure, and prints per type: every blocking key with the objects failing it and the objects failing ONLY it, every non-blocking note, the top combinations, and b_gain_objects (refused only because not every part qualified, with at least one whole component qualifying). Checks that depend on a failed one are marked unassessed, not guessed. Add 'vt' for numeric VT stack, format, geometry and component-only refusal diagnostics. The 'vt' mode reads cached uniformity only; unmeasured uniformity stays pending and no texture measurement is requested. Usage: IAI.TexCorrupt.Census [all|allreasons] [vt]
